blocks.prompt: 1. Consider a data set at monthly sales figures. A polynomial regression model \(P(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 + x - 3\) is fitted to this data. If the observed sales in the \(5^{\text{th}}\) month are 240 units, find the percentage error.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh regression model ka sawal hai: model ek andaza (prediction) deta hai, aur humein dekhna hai ke yeh andaza asal sale se kitna door hai.
Diya kya hai? Model \(P(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 + x - 3\), mahina 5, aur asal (observed) sale 240 units.
Find kya karna hai? Percentage error, yani ghalti asal value ka kitna percent hai.
Plan: pehle \(P(5)\) nikalein (yeh hi model ka andaza hai, aur Remainder Theorem ke mutabiq \(x - 5\) se divide karne par remainder bhi yahi hai), phir error \(=\) observed \(-\) predicted, phir observed se divide kar ke 100 se multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 + x - 3\); mahina \(x = 5\); observed sale \(= 240\) units.
Humein find karna hai: percentage error.
Tareeqa: Bilkul Example 8 wala: Error \(=\) Observed \(-\) Predicted, aur
\[\text{\% error} = \left|\dfrac{\text{Error}}{\text{Observed}}\right| \times 100\]
Predicted value \(P(5)\) hai. Remainder Theorem kehta hai ke \(P(x)\) ko \(x - 5\) se divide karein to remainder \(P(5)\) hi aata hai, is liye lambi division ki zaroorat nahi, seedha \(x = 5\) rakh dena kaafi hai.

Lafzon ko numbers mein badlein
\[x = 5\]
\[\text{Observed} = 240\]
\[\text{Predicted} = P(5)\]
Kyun: Sawal kahani ki shakal mein hai, pehle us mein se maths nikalni hai. "5th month" model ka input hai, is liye \(x = 5\). Jo 240 units asal mein bike, woh observed value hai, yani haqeeqat. Model jo batayega woh predicted value hai, yani andaza.

Predicted value \(P(5)\) nikalein
\[P(5) = 5^3 + 2(5)^2 + 5 - 3\]
\[= 125 + 2(25) + 5 - 3\]
\[= 125 + 50 + 5 - 3\]
\[= 177\]
Kyun: Model ka 5th mahine ka andaza \(x = 5\) par us ki value hai. Pehle powers: \(5^3 = 5 \times 5 \times 5 = 125\) aur \(5^2 = 25\); phir \(2 \times 25 = 50\); phir jama aur minus: \(125 + 50 = 175\), \(175 + 5 = 180\), \(180 - 3 = 177\).
Dhyan dein: \(2(5)^2\) ko \((2 \times 5)^2 = 100\) mat banaiye; power sirf 5 par hai, 2 par nahi.

Error nikalein
\[\text{Error} = 240 - 177\]
\[= 63\]
Kyun: Error ka matlab hai haqeeqat aur andaze ka farq: observed minus predicted. Yeh positive aaya, matlab model ne 63 units kam bataye.

Percentage error nikalein
\[\text{\% error} = \dfrac{|63|}{240} \times 100\]
\[= \dfrac{6300}{240}\]
\[= 26.25\]
Kyun: Percentage hamesha asal (observed) value ke muqable mein li jati hai, is liye 240 se divide kiya, 177 se nahi. Book ki Example 8 mein bhi observed 40 se divide hua hai. Modulus \(| \; |\) is liye ke error negative bhi ho to percentage positive hi likhi jaye.
Dhyan dein: 177 se divide karein to 35.59% aata hai, jo ghalat hai. Yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[26.25\% \text{ of } 240 = 0.2625 \times 240\]
\[= 63 \;\checkmark\]
\[177 + 63 = 240 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 240 ka 26.25% wapas 63 deta hai, aur andaza plus error wapas asal sale 240 deta hai. Dono baatein sahi hain, is liye jawab pakka hai.
Khud sochiye: agar asal sale 177 hoti to percentage error kya hota? (Jawab: 0%, kyunke model bilkul sahi hota.)
blocks.final_answer: Percentage error \(= 26.25\%\) (model ka andaza \(P(5) = 177\) units hai, jo asal 240 se 63 kam hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Exercise 9.2 ki answer key (book page 302, PDF 307) mein 10 jawab hain, lekin kitab mein sirf 7 sawal chhape hain (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8). Is liye key ke number sawalon se match nahi karte. Key ka jawab 1, \(26.25\%\), isi sawal ka hai aur hamare hal se milta hai. Key ke jawab 2 ("\(x = -1\) is a valid point"), 5 ("CRC = 20") aur 10 ("Code word is not valid ...") kisi chhape hue sawal ke nahi hain, unhein chhor dein.
